restaurant.disclaimer: Always confirm with the restaurant. Broth and seasoning may contain pork even when the menu name doesn't say so.

insight.rxSaturated: Demand is already met — hold and monitor.
insight.rxGrowing: Demand is rising faster than supply — add pork-free options now.
insight.rxEmpty: Real demand, zero infrastructure — seed the first venues.

about.title: Data & method
about.source_localdata: LOCALDATA (local-government business permit data) — every restaurant nationwide, with operating status, address and coordinates.
about.source_tourapi: TourAPI (Korea Tourism Organization) — representative and served-menu text for restaurants.
about.source_datalab: Korea Tourism Data Lab — Muslim and foreign visitor distribution by region (the demand side).
pipelineSteps: Filter LOCALDATA to operating restaurants, drop alcohol-license venues.
Match restaurant names against exclude tokens (pork, alcohol) and include tokens (seafood, chicken, beef, vegetarian, Muslim-cuisine).
Cross-check candidate menus against TourAPI menu text.
Phone-verify a sample of candidates for pork-free status and willingness to cooperate.
Compare the verified supply against Data Lab visitor demand to compute a per-district gap index (229 시군구).
about.openDataBody: The resulting per-district gap dataset is intended for release under the Korea Open Government License so existing apps and local governments can reuse it.
about.limitsBody: This prototype runs on mock data. Broth and seasoning can contain pork even when a menu name does not say so — always confirm with the restaurant.
